description: Coaching cards for UTS credit-card balance-transfer outbound, Bahasa + English triggers. Each card fires when a trigger phrase appears in customer speech. Latency target: <2s from utterance to card.

cards.title: Objection: Too expensive / rate too high
cards.suggestion: Reframe the rate vs. their current card. Script: 'Actually Puan, that's exactly why — standard credit card rate around eighteen percent. Balance transfer rate kita tiga point lima sahaja. So Puan save almost fifteen percent setahun.'

cards.title: Objection: Busy / not a good time
cards.suggestion: Don't push. Offer specific callback windows. Script: 'Oh okay Puan, saya faham. Bila convenient untuk saya call balik? Pagi or petang better for you?'

cards.title: Objection: Need to ask spouse / think about it
cards.suggestion: Don't pressure. Offer transfer to human closer for detailed Q&A. Script: 'Of course Puan. Saya nak suggest — saya tak close sekarang, tapi transfer kepada colleague yang boleh jelaskan detail. Puan boleh tanya apa-apa. Okay?'

cards.title: Positive intent signal — prepare for transfer
cards.suggestion: Customer is engaged. Initiate warm transfer. Script: 'Great Puan, terima kasih. Saya nak sambungkan kepada colleague saya yang handle application side. One moment ya.'

cards.title: HARD OPT-OUT — stop pitch immediately
cards.suggestion: STOP PITCH. Acknowledge, confirm removal, end call. Script: 'Baik Puan, tak apa. Saya akan update system supaya Puan tak terima call lagi. Terima kasih, have a good day.' Log as DNC.

cards.title: REMINDER: Disclose effective interest rate
cards.suggestion: PIAM requires you to state the effective rate after the promotional period. Add: 'Selepas tempoh promosi dua belas bulan, rate revert ke standard card rate, which is around lapan belas peratus.'

cards.title: Third-party answered — DO NOT disclose reason
cards.suggestion: Do not disclose reason for call. Script: 'Oh okay, tak apa. Boleh tolong sampaikan Puan {{customer_name}} kalau sempat, panggil balik {{callback_number}}? Terima kasih.'
